This item can be obtained on reaching a total of 50 levels. It is untradeable and gives all of the following when opened:

Main Full Rigged Sail x1
Carronade (14) x1
Check (10 million㌦) x1
Tristan's Sword x1
Memorandum of Secret No-war Pact x1 (no-trade)
Fine Tribute Goods (Large Ships) x2
Red Panda (Brown) x1

comments.author: Beomi
comments.body: Special Shipbuilding Improvement Permit(non-tradable) X 10 added since July/12/2023

wiki:
How to obtain: reach a total of 50 levels in any class and accept chest from the Record > Challenge Mission menu.

Receive all of the following:

Main Full Rigged Sail
Carronade (14)
Check (10 million㌦) x1
Tristan's Sword
Memorandum of Secret No-war Pact x1 (non-tradeable)
Fine Tribute Goods (Large Ships)
Red Panda (Brown)
Special Shipbuilding Improvement Permit x10 (non-tradeable)
